summary: The diff implements most of the requested Razorpay and AdSense integration. REQ-1 (backend), REQ-2 (frontend modal + hooks), REQ-3 (Razorpay checkout hook), REQ-4 (backend AdSense), and REQ-5 (frontend AdSense script + ad units in Layout) are largely present. However, several specific acceptance criteria have evidence gaps: the Settings page modifications for REQ-2 (Razorpay Setup button) and REQ-5 (AdSense configuration section) are not visible in the diff. The Upgrade.tsx page modifications for REQ-3 are not shown. The ad unit placeholder in VideoPlayer.tsx is not shown. The useRazorpayConfig hook calls 'isRazorpayConfiguredLegacy()' instead of the specified 'isRazorpayConfigured()'.

missing_requirements.requirement: A 'Razorpay Setup' button appears in the Settings page for authenticated users; modal opens with Key ID and Key Secret fields
missing_requirements.reason: Settings.tsx is not included in the diff summary. There is no evidence the Settings page was modified to add the Razorpay Setup button.

missing_requirements.requirement: Upgrade page shows a Razorpay payment button labeled with INR pricing (e.g. 499/month); Razorpay option is only shown when isRazorpayConfigured() returns true
missing_requirements.reason: Upgrade.tsx is not present in the diff summary. There is no evidence the Upgrade page was modified to include the Razorpay payment option.

missing_requirements.requirement: Settings page has an AdSense Configuration section with a Publisher ID input field; saving calls setAdSensePublisherId
missing_requirements.reason: Settings.tsx is not shown in the diff. No evidence of an AdSense configuration section being added to the Settings page.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ad unit placeholders (ins.adsbygoogle) are rendered below the video player in VideoPlayer.tsx
missing_requirements.reason: VideoPlayer.tsx is not shown in the diff. There is no evidence an AdSenseUnit was added below the video player.
